message.content:
To answer your questions:

1. I’m not entirely sure when they were first discovered; they were found during a recent examination.
2. I haven't really had any specific symptoms that led to this; it was just something that came up during my check-up.
3. I haven't noticed any fatigue, weight loss, or dizziness. I really just have that mild pigmentation over my finger joints and knees that you mentioned.
4. I haven't had any recent illnesses or major stressors that I can think of. I did have a hospitalization about five years ago for a chest opacity, but I was never told it was tuberculosis and I didn't receive any treatment for it. I also don't take any steroids and there's no history of this kind of thing in my family.
